project.name: Sourcerer Backend
project.purpose: AI-powered RAG backend with Google Drive ingestion, incremental processing, tagging, embedding, and Qdrant storage.

flow: Google Drive folder is recursively scanned and supported files are downloaded in memory.
Folder metadata is extracted from the breadcrumb path and merged with optional course/year fields.
The Celery worker computes a file hash and checks SQLite tracking for NEW, SKIP, or UPDATE.
UPDATE deletes prior Qdrant vectors for the same file_id before continuing.
The file is parsed through a MIME-based parser factory.
The parsed document is chunked using an automatic strategy selector.
Chunks are tagged with Groq and a strict JSON schema.
Tagged chunks are embedded with Gemini Embeddings 2.
Embedded chunks are upserted to Qdrant with dense and sparse vectors.
The tracking store is updated only after the pipeline completes successfully.

known_gaps: The README still describes an older mixed set of pipeline stage numbers.
The ingestion route returns base64 content and also enqueues background work, so callers should not assume synchronous completion.
resume_notes: Prefer simple, testable changes over new abstractions.
Keep tracking updates after successful processing only.
Use the existing factories for parsing and chunking before adding new branches.
If adding new document types, update Drive support, parser selection, and tests together.
